<subject>Re: logistics strategy forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Emily is a Fremantle port authority board member and we have invited two other Fremantle board members. Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang, accepts, there is no need to send a backup. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, MSA
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Maxwell, Jessica  
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 11:47 AM
To:	Gonzales, Michelle
Subject:	FW: logistics strategy forum

FYI...

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	"Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@altnorcorp.com> 
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 10:47 AM
To:	Richmond, Darren
Subject:	logistics strategy forum


Mr. Richmond, 
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October.  Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend.  May I pass the information on to one of the other Board members here, or have you also invited others from our authority?
Thank you. 
Ellen Fisher 
</quoted>
